custodyProfile.reviewer: Sol curation pass 2026-10-01 (R2WCircle), complete pinned three-deployment allocation review
custodyProfile.uncertainty: Current allocations were enumerated at Ethereum block 26098754, Base block 52041959 and Arbitrum block 510719674 on 2026-10-01. Ethereum has one MorphoMarketV1AdapterV2 with seven funded USDC markets against cbBTC, WBTC, wstETH or WETH at 86% LLTV; its expected market assets sum exactly to adapter realAssets and vault totalAssets. Base has seven funded markets against cbBTC, wstETH, WETH or cbETH at 77% or 86% LLTV. Arbitrum has four funded collateralized markets against wstETH, WETH, WBTC or sUSDS at 86% or 94.5% LLTV plus an idle market. Every observed vault or adapter position has zero borrow shares and zero posted collateral. Exact deployed vault and adapter sources expose lending operations without a local borrowing surface. Gauntlet disclaims custody. On-chain custody, no local leverage and lending reuse are established at these blocks; legal segregation and insolvency rights remain unestablished, and parent USDC custody is inherited exposure. The shared wrapper-allocation review owns the structural assessment; these legal-custody enums do not describe whether USDC is lent.
